description: This file implements runtime and link-time HLSL shader code generation for Direct3D in the ANGLE graphics library. It includes functions for generating vertex, pixel, and geometry shaders, handling shader variable declarations, and managing shader linkages with support for multiview and point sprite emulation.

classes.name: BuiltinVarying
classes.description: Represents a built-in varying variable with semantic and index information.

classes.name: BuiltinVaryingsD3D
classes.description: Manages built-in varyings for different shader stages, ensuring correct semantics and indices based on metadata.

classes.name: BuiltinInfo
classes.description: Holds information about built-in variables for a shader stage.

classes.name: DynamicHLSL
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating HLSL shader code dynamically for different shader stages and configurations.

methods.name: generateVertexShaderForInputLayout
methods.description: Generates a vertex shader source with input layout and attributes.

methods.name: generatePixelShaderForOutputSignature
methods.description: Generates pixel shader output signature code based on output variables and layout.

methods.name: generatePixelShaderForHdrOutputSignature
methods.description: Generates HDR-specific pixel shader output signature code (STARBOARD only).

methods.name: generateComputeShaderForImage2DBindSignature
methods.description: Generates compute shader code for image2D binding layout.

methods.name: generateVaryingLinkHLSL
methods.description: Creates HLSL code linking varyings and built-in variables.

methods.name: generateShaderLinkHLSL
methods.description: Links vertex and fragment shaders into a complete HLSL shader program.

methods.name: generateGeometryShaderHLSL
methods.description: Generates geometry shader code based on primitive type and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateAttributeConversionHLSL
methods.description: Creates HLSL code for converting vertex attribute types.

methods.name: getPixelShaderOutputKey
methods.description: Determines the output variables for the pixel shader based on program and metadata.
